name: lombokclarion/table-sheet
description: Vendored PHP port of LombokTableSheet (github.com/codinglombok/LombokTableSheet, ports/php, v1.0.1). Table/spreadsheet data model, formula engine (tokenizer→Pratt parser→AST, no eval()), split/merge, CSV+JSON codecs. Fallback/cadangan consumption path — the primary path is the external sibling library `lomboktablesheet` on npm/Packagist per project directive 2026-07-22.
